subject: crm.records

recordTypes.summary: An index record that names an authoritative policy definition.

fields.summary: The exact human-readable policy title.
Whether reported project progress must be derived from promoted task records.
Whether milestone work-item counts must remain distinct from promoted task counts.
Whether every project health statement requires an explicit observed basis.
Whether project-status and milestone writes require exact user confirmation.

content.summary: Policy bodies are loaded through explicit portable document sources.

recordTypes.summary: Machine-readable task creation rules selected from one definition authority.

fields.summary: The exact human-readable task policy title.
Whether each exact task-create batch requires operator confirmation.
The maximum bounded task candidates inspected before proposing a create.
Portable task fields used to search for possible duplicates before create.
The portable lifecycle state assigned to a newly captured task.
The exact task context classifications allowed by the selected policy.
Whether every captured task must resolve one exact project before create.

content.summary: The normalized task-capture rules contain no portable body content.

recordTypes.summary: An organization participating in CRM relationships and work.

fields.summary: The organization display name.
The configured organization classification.
The portable organization lifecycle state.
Portable organization classification tags.
Exact related project resource identities.
Exact related contact resource identities.

content.summary: Organization records have no portable body content.

recordTypes.summary: A CRM contact whose authority and relationships remain explicit.

fields.summary: The contact display name.
The contact email address when known.
The contact role classification.
The contact lifecycle state.
The configured relationship disposition.
Explicit authority labels assigned to this contact.
Exact related organization resource identities.

content.summary: Contact records have no portable body content.

recordTypes.summary: A bounded body of work related to organizations and tasks.

fields.summary: The project display name.
The configured project classification.
The portable project lifecycle state.
Exact related organization resource identities.
Exact related task resource identities.

content.summary: Project records have no portable body content.

recordTypes.summary: A bounded work item that can be related to one or more projects.

fields.summary: The task title describing the intended work.
The portable task lifecycle state.
The configured work-context classification.
The exact related project record identity used for bounded project-status queries.
Exact related project resource identities.
Exact provider-scoped person identities for the assigned operators.
The pinned calendar date for the task's next action.

content.summary: Task records have no portable body content.

recordTypes.summary: A project milestone whose work-item progress and health remain distinct from promoted tasks.

fields.summary: The exact project record identity that owns this milestone.
The observed count of completed milestone work items.
The observed total count of milestone work items.
The source-defined qualitative milestone progress classification.
The source-defined qualitative milestone health classification.

content.summary: Milestone records have no portable body content.

recordTypes.summary: A meeting record anchored to one canonical recording identity.

fields.summary: The meeting display title.
The configured meeting classification.
The exact canonical recording resource identity.
Exact related organization resource identities.
Provider-scoped participant identities that are not CRM contact IDs.

content.summary: Meeting records have no portable body content.

recordTypes.summary: A transcript-grounded document linked to its canonical source meeting.

fields.summary: The human-readable summary title.
The document classification for meeting summaries.
A bounded plain-language summary description.
The canonical source recording link used for attribution and deduplication.

content.summary: The transcript-grounded meeting summary body in Markdown.

limitations: This model defines portable meaning and shapes; it does not assert that any selected provider maps every record or field.
Provider-scoped meeting participant identities do not become CRM contact identities without a separate resolution contract.
Policy bodies remain external canonical sources and are not embedded in policy index records.
